candidates.name: closed_set_retrieval
candidates.hypothesis: If some errors reflect qualified or wrapped answers despite an allowed label appearing in the response, retrieving nearby examples and canonicalizing against labels listed in the current prompt will improve on ambiguity_budgeted_retrieval with only a small context increase.
components: label-set extraction from the current prompt

candidates.name: contrastive_label_cards
candidates.hypothesis: If reusable label-specific cues are more informative than a single representative example, smoothed query-matched cue-enrichment cards will improve on class_signature_memory while reducing its aggregate context length.
components: one verified exemplar per matching label

candidates.name: correction_episode_memory
candidates.hypothesis: If learned mistakes help mainly as local contrasts, retrieving a few distinct similar error-correction episodes together with positive verified anchors will improve on pairwise_error_rules without broadening its rule context.
